sources.title: breast-cancer-segmentation · GitHub Topics · GitHub
sources.snippet: Breast cancer histopathology image segmentation using U-Net. This repository implements U-Net for accurate segmentation of cancerous regions. It includes data augmentation, mixed precision training, checkpointing, and evaluation metrics like Dice score to improve model performance.

sources.title: Deep Segmentation Techniques for Breast Cancer Diagnosis
sources.snippet: This model's ability to perform pixel-perfect segmentation is particularly crucial for the complex visuals associated with breast cancer diagnostics, offering insights far beyond conventional methods.
